p.i: Breuem, Zoile, dicis hunc libellum: Osi possit idem omnibus videri!

Hunc quanquam illepidum & malum libellum, Vos o perlepidi mei sodales, Quaso, sumite blandiore vultu, Deinde perlegite usque ad umbilicum. Nam vos id rogat ille Beza vester. Sed sic perlegite, o boni sodales, Ut nec falsa aliqua eruditionis Nostra opinio, nec mei tuendi Cura nominis vlla, vos moretur. Figatis, potius, vel hinc, vel illinc, Stellulisque, obelisque, virgulisque, Cultu splendidum ut decentiore, Testetur titulo tenus parentem. Id vero mala turba Zoilorum Damnabit (fateor) nihilque dicet Hic praeter titulum meum videri. Sed clamet licet usque, & usque, & usque, Sit totus volo vester hic libellus, Quum vester quoque sit poeta totus.

page.notes: The initial letters B and H are large decorative initials, joined to their words. The long-s glyph is printed as a f-like form in places; rendered as s. The symbol for "et" is printed as &, and the "usque" forms appear as Ꞩ-like abbreviations, transcribed as usque. Some ornaments and rules on the page are not text.
